reforms.description: The President announced a series of measures in February to reduce the outflow of U.S. private capital, including the extension of the Interest Equalisation Tax (IET) to bank loans to borrowers in developed countries.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By limiting capital outflow and encouraging domestic investment, these measures aim to stabilize the economy and promote growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The measures were announced and put into effect to address the capital outflow issue.
reforms.importance_rationale: The measures represent a significant policy adjustment aimed at stabilizing the balance of payments and encouraging domestic investment.
reforms.source_quote: To reduce this outflow, the President announced a series of measures in February.
